findings.claim: The prompt only asks the Engineer to report two sensor gaps: users/membership (lines 62-63) and invalid body via the adapter (lines 90-92). Several corrections it orders have no Inspector sensor: backend-restart waiting for /readyz (line 117), tail -n (line 116), keeping the positive report from being overwritten (lines 109-111; today smoke.mjs:447 and :574 write the same stem, smoke-report), PEC by existsSync (smoke.mjs:215 and :339 are hardcoded), and the realpath entrypoint (line 113). Without sensors, a regression to the maestro's old behavior would go unnoticed, which repeats the delivery review's complaint about unobserved evidence.
findings.fix: Ask the report to list every correction with no Inspector sensor (readyz, tail, report suffix, PEC, entrypoint, membership, body via adapter) so the maestro can route them to a restricted Inspector iteration before the delivery review.

findings.claim: 'Remove every DETRAN_LOCAL_* except DETRAN_LOCAL_ROLES of the phase' does not say that the final restore must pass the five default roles explicitly. The Inspector sensor (contract.test.mjs:564-573) expects the literal string 'technical-admin,agency-admin,field-agent,rait-coordinator,dash-operator' in the last backend-restart. If the Engineer removes ROLES on restore and relies on the default in detran-stack.sh:455, the result is equivalent but the sensor goes red. smoke.mjs:454 already does this correctly (restartFor(defaultRoles)).
findings.fix: State that restore keeps DETRAN_LOCAL_ROLES=<defaultRoles> explicit and removes only ACTOR_ID and the other inherited DETRAN_LOCAL_* variables.

findings.claim: The prompt asks for proof, with file and line, from the runtime or STYNX that an active membership without membership_roles is enough. notes: Ratification: lines 35-42 list all the maestro production edits in TASK-0007-maestro-adenda.md:6-9 (portal-fixture.sh, fixture-portal, topological build, pg_isready 127.0.0.1, SEFAZ env -i, tenant/idempotency headers, Dashboard app=portal, per-phase actor). The write boundary (lines 23-25) covers these files and requires each change to be classified as ratified, corrected or reverted. The Inspector took over the A6 test in contract.test.mjs:40-96 (TASK-0011.md:3), and the prompt forbids editing tests (lines 27-31). This resolves delivery-review finding 1 for the TASK-0007 boundary. Finding 2 (40-fixtures SQL) was already resolved by TASK-0006 under PC-2640674bbd29832f (plan.md:541-548).

Inspector reds can be attributed to production without editing tests. (a) tenant_mismatch in arrays (contract.test.mjs:461) depends only on smoke.mjs:199. (b) The actor sensor (contract.test.mjs:485-592) stubs bash from PATH, and smoke.mjs:403-408 invokes 'bash' without an absolute path, so the stub intercepts it. The sensor expects ACTOR_ID only in MEDICO=b0000002, which is compatible with removing it in restartFor (smoke.mjs:423-428). (c) The literal SEFAZ sensor (contract.test.mjs:594-614) fails only because of the static TS import at sefaz-adapter-smoke.mjs:2. tsx 4.23.13 is a root devDependency (package.json:90) and exposes tsx/esm/api (register), so the literal command can be kept without touching package.json.

C-02-02 errors are feasible without touching packages: http-adapter.ts:111 and :137-151 normalize the {error:{category,retryable,providerStatus}} envelope into SefazAdapterError, and BUSINESS_ERROR retryable=false is not retried. A semantically invalid body can go through the adapter, for example issueGuide({debtId:'unknown'}) against sefaz-mock.mjs:149. Unknown reference and unknown refund produce NOT_FOUND/404. Raw 405/Allow and malformed JSON via fetch match CTG-0002:99-104. Port 0 through the factory avoids conflicting with a running stack on 3999.

A6/A7 are preserved: the DB_NAME guard (portal-fixture.sh:15-16) comes before any docker/psql and stays. The order preflight → fixture-portal → first backend-restart (smoke.mjs:431-491) ensures that membership for the default actor 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002 (detran-runtime.ts:321-323; absent from 00-fixtures-core.sql) exists before any authenticated read. auth.users.email is UNIQUE (02-auth.sql:37) and memberships is UNIQUE(tenant_id,user_id) (02-auth.sql:76), which matches the ON CONFLICT clauses the prompt prescribes and the fresh pattern (00-fixtures-core.sql:42). The prompt forbids membership_roles/groups, forbids any policy/RLS change and requires BLOCKED if it cannot prove the membership without roles is enough. The negative smoke keeps the preflight before any fixture.
RLS: the portal-fixture.sh:22-23 fixture uses set_config('app.role','owner'), the same pattern as the canonical seeds (20-/27-/50-fixtures). It adds no new bypass.

Remaining CH risk: ch-fixture.sh:33-41 and :99 tie the professional and biometric_check to b0000002. With the default actor, the RECEPCAO/ADMIN_CLINICA probes depend on requireScope/policy not requiring that actor to be linked. The prompt handles this correctly with BLOCKED plus file and line instead of a CLI workaround (lines 26-27). In the live run, the maestro must confirm that these two probes still reach the adapter.

SEFAZ lifecycle: the revision.test.mjs:117-121 node stub intercepts only the relative argv, and waits for pids/sefaz-mock.pid. The prompt keeps both (lines 98-101 and 114-116). Changing to tail -n keeps revision.test.mjs:688 matching.
